encoding: UTF-8 of canonical JSON: recursively sort object keys lexicographically; preserve array order; no whitespace; JSON.stringify primitive values.
fileHash: digest({path,content}), including exact source text and final newline
sourceHash: digest(array of {path,hash}, sorted by path using localeCompare(path,"en"))
artifactHash: digest(entire parsed artifact JSON object); not a bytecode hash or raw JSON-file checksum
